title: CZ Wants to ‘Eradicate’ Address Poisoning After Massive $50M Loss
summary: CZ proposes a fix to address poisoning after an investor loses $50M, as Changpeng Zhao has urged wallet warnings, blacklist checks, and spam filters to reduce phishing losses across the crypto sector.
